newsitem.title: USA: Russian millers said to seek higher quality wheat.
newsitem.headline: Russian millers said to seek higher quality wheat.

text.p: Russian millers will be looking to import some higher baking quality wheat in 1996/97, to add to lower quality domestic wheat, a U.S. agriculture attache said in a report released Monday.
The Moscow-based attache said overall imports will be about 3.0 million tonnes in 1996/97, with a high share of imports going to the Russian Far East.
"Prospects for imports of wheat with high baking qualities are better, as millers are interested in adding it to domestic wheat," the report said.
The report, dated October 4, was released in Washington.
